help.title: How to Use
help.step1: Tap [Create Culture Box], then pick a country and search a school.
help.step2: Add embed URL, date, contents, and message. (Use [Add Exchange Box] for multiple boxes.)
help.step3: Tap [Save & Preview] to check the box and invoice.
help.step4: Tap [Share Link] and send the copied URL.
